name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker — the token's haste is not granted to the battlefield
notes: Seen in the sweep diff. 'Create a token that's a copy of …, except it has haste' was parsed as a global haste grant with a junk filter (about 40 cards with token-copy or token-defining text did this). Keyword, quoted-ability and add-type parsers now skip a subject that contains 'create'.

call: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
{T}: Create a token that's a copy of target nonlegendary creature you control, except it has haste. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
